"DSM-5 aims to avoid stigma and ensure clinical care for individuals who see and feel themselves to be a different gender than their assigned gender. It replaces the diagnostic name 'Gender Identity Disorder' with 'Gender Dysphoria', as well as makes other important clarifications in the criteria. It is important to note that gender non-conformity is not in itself a mental disorder. The critical element of gender dysphoria is the presence of clinically significant distress associated with the condition."

In short, the people who literally wrote the definition of mental disorders 100% reject the notion that being transgender means being mentally disordered.

The fundamental error of your argument is you presume that no term limits means people can serve indefinitely. This is not the case. Legislators would finally have an excuse when they don't get all they promise accomplished, just as the executive currently does: "I didn't have enough time." Instead, having no term limits continually rewards politicians who actually please their constituents. And again, it prevents the government from blocking a favorable candidate from being on the ballot.

Also, our foundational document is maintained and amended by the government, but this comes down to a battle in semantics.
